content.overview: Article 308 provides that in Part XIV, unless the context otherwise requires, the expression ‘State’ does not include the State of Jammu and Kashmir (historical text; apply current constitutional map of States and Union territories as applicable).
content.glance: Definition clause for Part XIV (Services). Historical exclusion of J&K; apply current State/UT structure.
content.study:
Article 308 is the interpretation clause for Part XIV (Services under the Union and the States). Historically it excluded Jammu and Kashmir from ‘State’ in this Part. Current application follows the Constitution as amended and the present organisation of States and UTs.

Examination: Part XIV definition; historical J&K note; use current map in application.

sections.heading: Key point
sections.body: In Part XIV, unless the context otherwise requires, ‘State’ is defined as provided (historical exclusion of J&K; apply current constitutional position).

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 308 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 308 is the interpretation provision for Part XIV. In its historical form it provided that, unless the context otherwise requires, ‘State’ in that Part did not include the State of Jammu and Kashmir. The current application of Part XIV follows the Constitution as amended and the present organisation of States and Union territories.
